g.data-label: Fold the top bar up or down
Crew assists: sails, watches, speed log and navigation

text.tspan: Sailmaster Shortens sail when she strains and makes sail again as the wind eases.
Bosun trims the yards Braces the yards to the best angle for the wind, always.
Mate keeps the watches Spreads the hands evenly when they wear out or the crew changes.
Mate heaves the log each hour Reads the speed off the log line every hour for your reckoning, with a little error.
Helm follows the route Steers for each mark on your chart route in turn.
Navigator shoots the noon sight Takes the sun up from the forenoon watch and marks noon when it dips.
Lookout takes the bearings Takes bearings on landmarks as they come in sight and plots the fix.
Sky chart Draws the altitude and bearing grid, the constellation lines and their names over the sky.

text.tspan: Man-of-war birds hang high over the ship. Land cannot be far off.
